LESSON: MIXTURES

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade five
Subject: SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY
Strand: MIXTURES, ELEMENTS AND COMPOUNDS Strand Sub Strand Specific learning outcomes Su
Topic 2.1: Mixtures
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 14

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Mixtures, part of MIXTURES, ELEMENTS AND COMPOUNDS Strand Sub Strand Specific learning outcomes Su in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade five SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY.

Key inquiry question: How are mixtures categorised? 2. Why are mixtures separated?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Mixtures together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and collaboration: The learner develops listening and speaking skills when contributing to group decision making as they

separate mixtures using appropriate methods.

• Learning to learn: The learner reflects on their own experiences when carrying out activities with peers to separate different types of mixtures.

Values:
• Social justice: The learner enhances equity when according others equal opportunities in sharing responsibilities as they work in groups to

separate mixtures.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs)

• Social-economic issues (financial literacy): The learner appreciates applications of separating mixtures in day-to-day life as a process of value

addition.
